raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (Home + Light Dumbbells)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary return_to_base:
    name "Rebuild baseline movement capacity, core-pelvic control, and work tolerance without impact"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Acclimatisation A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 2x5..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Acclimatisation B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 2x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          prone_Y 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Acclimatisation C":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          neck_roll 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Ramp A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Ramp B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Ramp C":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Build A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Build B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_W 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Build C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Consolidate A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Consolidate B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          prone_W 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Consolidate C":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m

goals.name: Rebuild baseline movement capacity, core-pelvic control, and work tolerance without impact
